info.color_schemes_accent: Links, sale prices and badges. Keep it at 4.5:1 contrast or more against the background.
info.color_schemes_border: Input borders, dividers and bordered cards. Keep it at 3:1 contrast or more against the background.
info.density: The space above and below every section and between the items of a grid.
info.logo_asset: Set by the Studio. A logo picked above takes precedence.
info.footer_text: The brand's one line, then what shoppers look for here: the address, opening hours and email.
info.footer_show_follow_on_shop: Lets customers follow the shop in the Shop app. Shows only when Shop Pay is on.
info.footer_show_newsletter: Subscribers are added to your customer list with email marketing consent. Hidden on pages that have a newsletter section.
info.footer_layout: Columns sizes each column to its content. Big wordmark sets the shop's name large across the bottom. Split puts the brand and newsletter on one side and the menus on the other, and Menus in a grid sets the menus 2 × 2. Newsletter band opens with the signup on its own color scheme. Top bar puts the name and social links above a line. One row and Centered minimal suit a shop with little to say.
info.footer_other_links: Shown as text links, like Strava or a blog. A link to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, YouTube or Pinterest shows its icon.
info.social_links_setting: Social links come from the theme settings, under Social media.
info.logo_setting: The logo comes from the theme settings, under Logo.
info.hero_video: Plays muted on a loop in place of the image, with controls to pause it. It waits for a press when the customer's device asks for reduced motion or the theme's motion is off.
info.logo_list_image: The image's alt text names the logo for screen readers.
info.main_collection_enable_filtering: Set up filters in the Shopify admin with the Search & Discovery app.
info.main_collection_products_per_page: Also how many each Load more adds on mobile. 15 to 30 works best.
info.main_search_no_results_collection: Its products show when a search finds nothing. Leave it empty to list the shop's collections instead.
info.main_cart_empty_collection: Its first four products show on the cart page when the cart is empty. Leave it empty to show the shop's first products.
info.testimonials_author_detail: For example a city or "Verified buyer".
info.testimonials_image: A portrait of the author, shown beside their name in the With portraits layout.
info.header_show_localization: Shown only when the shop sells in more than one country or language. The footer always shows them.
info.related_products_intent: Shopify picks related products automatically. Set complementary products in the Shopify admin with the Search & Discovery app.
info.custom_liquid_setting: Add app snippets, tracking code or embeds. Liquid and HTML both work.
info.announcement_bar_layout: Rotate shows one message at a time, changing every 5 seconds. Stack shows them all.
info.slideshow_autoplay: Customers can pause it. It doesn't play when the theme's animations are off or a customer's device asks for reduced motion.
info.multicolumn_image_size: Small suits icons. Large fills the column's width.
info.video_video: Takes precedence over a YouTube or Vimeo URL.
info.video_cover_image: Shown until a customer plays the video.
info.type_scale_ratio: How much larger each heading level is than the one below it, from the body size up. Smaller on mobile.
info.type_display_size: The size of the largest headings, like the hero heading, on desktop. Never smaller than a main heading.
info.hero_image_mobile: Shown on phones instead of the image, for a crop that suits a portrait screen. Without an image, it shows on every screen.
info.type_display_size_mobile: The display size on a 390px phone screen; it grows from there to the desktop size. Never larger than the desktop size.
info.shape_family: Rounds buttons, inputs, cards, images and badges together. Round makes buttons and badges pills.
info.collapsible_content_text: Shown on every product. For facts that differ per product, like materials, connect a product metafield with the dynamic source button, or leave it empty.
info.shipping_note_text: Shown next to the buy button: the shop's shipping costs, delivery times and returns window. The free-shipping threshold from the theme settings follows it, then links to the shipping and refund policies once they're set in the Shopify admin, under Settings › Policies.
info.card_hover: The second image is the product's second media; a product with one image zooms instead. Only on devices with a mouse.
info.card_text_style: The title and price of minimal and detailed cards. Quiet: smaller than the body text. Caps: small, in capitals. Bold: the title in bold, the price muted. Editorial cards keep their large title.
info.card_anatomy: Every card shows a sale or sold out badge. Minimal: image, title and price. Detailed: adds the vendor, color swatches and a rating from a reviews app. Editorial: a large title and no button.
info.media_treatment: For product and collection images. Full-bleed crops each one to fill its box. Framed shows the whole image, inset in its box on the tint. Other photos always fill their box.
info.media_tint: For product and collection images. Suits cut-out product photos: their white background takes the tint. Pick a light color, or clear it for none.
info.motion: Subtle fades in the sections set to reveal on scroll as they come into view, and eases hovers. Expressive raises them and slowly zooms the hero and slides. Always off for customers who reduce motion on their device, and nothing that shows first fades in.
info.type_banner_heading: A line or two. Press Enter where the line should break.
info.marquee_speed: Pauses on hover, and customers can pause it. It stays still when a customer's device asks for reduced motion, or with Motion set to None.
info.editorial_split_quote: A pull quote after the text, at a heading size. Leave it empty for none.
info.lookbook_position: From the left and top edges of the image, in percent. Place it on the product in the photo.
info.comparison_table_options: The products or options to compare, a column each. Leave one empty to hide its column.
info.press_quotes_logo: Shown in place of the publication name. The name stays its text alternative.
info.hero_overlay_opacity: A layer of the color scheme's background over the media, so the text stays readable.
info.header_sticky: Stays at the top of the page: hides as customers scroll down and comes back as they scroll up.
info.header_logo_height: For a logo image. Without one, the shop name shows at a heading size.
info.main_product_gallery_layout: On mobile, the media always swipes, with thumbnails below.
info.main_product_sticky_buy_bar: Slides in at the bottom of the screen with the title, price and an add to cart button once the buy buttons scroll away.
info.contact_form_heading: Leave blank to show the page's title.
info.contact_form_details: Email, phone number, address and opening hours.
info.free_shipping_threshold: The order total, in the store currency, from which shipping is free, as your shipping rates in Settings › Shipping and delivery set it. The cart shows how far the shopper is from it, and the shipping note shows it. Leave blank to show neither.
info.size_guide_page: The shop page with the size chart, shown in a dialog next to the variant picker. Create it in the Shopify admin, under Online Store › Pages. Nothing shows until a page is picked.
